lessons.title: Hello, Can You Hear Me? First Listening
lessons.title_vi: Alo, nghe rõ không? Bài nghe đầu tiên
objectives: Hear the difference between similar sounds: live / leave, ship / sheep
Notice final sounds like the t in cat
Catch simple times and places in one sentence

questions.objective: Hear the difference between live and leave
questions.audio_text: I live in a small house near the river.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the house?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về ngôi nhà?
options: I leave a small house near the river.
I live in a small house near the river.
I love a small house near the river.
questions.answer: I live in a small house near the river.
questions.explanation: "Live" has a short /ɪ/ sound; "leave" has a long /i/ sound. The speaker says "live in", which means where they stay.
questions.explanation_vi: "Live" /lɪv/ có âm i ngắn, còn "leave" /liv/ có âm i dài (kéo dài hơn, miệng căng hơn). Người nói dùng "live in" = sống ở.

questions.objective: Catch the key verb in a video-call question
questions.audio_text: Can you hear me now?
questions.prompt: Which question did you hear at the start of the video call?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu hỏi nào lúc bắt đầu cuộc gọi video?
questions.explanation: The speaker says "hear", which is about sound. This is a very common question when the connection is bad.
questions.explanation_vi: Người nói dùng "hear" (nghe), liên quan đến âm thanh. Đây là câu rất hay dùng khi mạng yếu trong lúc gọi video.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between ship and sheep
questions.audio_text: There is a sheep in the photo.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the photo?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về bức ảnh?
options: There is a ship in the photo.
There is a sheep in the photo.
There is a shop in the photo.
questions.answer: There is a sheep in the photo.
questions.explanation: "Sheep" has a long /i/ sound, like in "see". "Ship" has a short /ɪ/ sound, like in "sit".
questions.explanation_vi: "Sheep" (con cừu) có âm i dài như trong "see". "Ship" (con tàu) có âm i ngắn, bật nhanh như trong "sit".

questions.objective: Catch a time in a sentence about a daily routine
questions.audio_text: I drink coffee at seven every morning.
questions.prompt: What time does the speaker drink coffee?
questions.prompt_vi: Người nói uống cà phê lúc mấy giờ?
questions.explanation: The speaker says "at seven every morning". "Seven" and "eleven" both end in -ven, so listen for the start of the word.
questions.explanation_vi: Người nói nói "at seven every morning" (bảy giờ mỗi sáng). "Seven" và "eleven" đều kết thúc bằng -ven, nên hãy chú ý phần đầu của từ.

questions.objective: Hear final consonant sounds like t and p
questions.audio_text: She has a black cat.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about what she has?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về thứ cô ấy có?
questions.explanation: The words cat, cap and car differ only in their last sound. English speakers say the final sound clearly, so listen to the very end of the word.
questions.explanation_vi: Cat, cap và car chỉ khác nhau ở âm cuối. Người Việt hay nuốt âm cuối, nhưng trong tiếng Anh âm cuối quyết định nghĩa của từ, nên hãy nghe kỹ phần cuối.

lessons.title: See You Soon! Planning to Meet
lessons.title_vi: Sắp gặp rồi! Lên kế hoạch gặp nhau
objectives: Hear the difference between thirteen / thirty and fifteen / fifty
Understand where and when people plan to meet
Hear the difference between walk and work

questions.objective: Hear the difference between thirteen and thirty
questions.audio_text: I will visit you in thirteen days. I already have my ticket.
questions.prompt: How many days until the visit?
questions.prompt_vi: Còn bao nhiêu ngày nữa thì đến chuyến thăm?
questions.explanation: In "thirteen", the stress is at the end: thir-TEEN, with a long /i/ sound. In "thirty", the stress is at the start: THIR-ty.
questions.explanation_vi: "Thirteen" nhấn ở cuối (thir-TEEN) và có âm "n" ở cuối. "Thirty" nhấn ở đầu (THIR-ty) và kết thúc bằng âm "ti" ngắn.

questions.objective: Understand where people plan to meet
questions.audio_text: Let's meet at the coffee shop near the park on Saturday.
questions.prompt: Where will they meet?
questions.prompt_vi: Họ sẽ gặp nhau ở đâu?
options: At the bookshop near the park
At the park near the station
At the coffee shop near the park
questions.answer: At the coffee shop near the park
questions.explanation: The speaker says "the coffee shop near the park". The park is only a landmark to help find the coffee shop.
questions.explanation_vi: Người nói nói "the coffee shop near the park" (quán cà phê gần công viên). Công viên chỉ là mốc để dễ tìm quán.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between walk and work
questions.audio_text: We can walk on the beach in the evening.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the beach?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về bãi biển?
options: We can work on the beach in the evening.
We can walk on the beach in the evening.
We can wake on the beach in the evening.
questions.answer: We can walk on the beach in the evening.
questions.explanation: In "walk", the l is silent and the vowel is open: /wɔk/. "Work" has an r sound: /wɜrk/.
questions.explanation_vi: Trong "walk" /wɔk/, chữ l câm và miệng mở tròn. "Work" /wɜrk/ có âm r, lưỡi cong lên. Đây là cặp từ người Việt rất hay nhầm.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between fifteen and fifty
questions.audio_text: The bus ticket costs fifty dollars, so I will take the train instead.
questions.prompt: How much does the bus ticket cost?
questions.prompt_vi: Vé xe buýt giá bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation: "Fifty" is stressed at the start: FIF-ty. "Fifteen" is stressed at the end: fif-TEEN. The price is high, so the speaker chooses the train.
questions.explanation_vi: "Fifty" nhấn ở đầu (FIF-ty), "fifteen" nhấn ở cuối (fif-TEEN). Vé đắt nên người nói chọn đi tàu thay vì xe buýt.

questions.objective: Understand advice before a visit
questions.audio_text: Don't forget to bring a warm jacket. It is very cold here in December.
questions.prompt: What should the listener bring?
questions.prompt_vi: Người nghe nên mang theo gì?
questions.explanation: "Don't forget to bring" introduces what to pack: a warm jacket, because December is cold there.
questions.explanation_vi: "Don't forget to bring" (đừng quên mang theo) giới thiệu món cần mang: áo khoác ấm, vì tháng Mười Hai ở đó rất lạnh.

lessons.title: Our Evening Calls: Daily Life on Video
lessons.title_vi: Những cuộc gọi buổi tối: Cuộc sống hằng ngày qua video
objectives: Understand reasons and problems during a video call
Follow the order of activities in a daily routine
Hear small differences like left / lost and thirty / thirteen

questions.objective: Understand the reason for calling back
questions.audio_text: Sorry, my internet is really slow tonight. Can I call you back in ten minutes from my phone?
questions.prompt: Why does the speaker want to call back?
questions.prompt_vi: Tại sao người nói muốn gọi lại?
options: Because the phone battery is low
Because they are busy at work
questions.explanation: The speaker says "my internet is really slow tonight", then offers to call back from their phone.
questions.explanation_vi: Người nói bảo "my internet is really slow tonight" (mạng tối nay rất chậm), rồi đề nghị gọi lại bằng điện thoại.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between left and lost
questions.audio_text: Wait a minute, I think I left my keys at the office. I need to go back and get them.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the keys?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về chùm chìa khóa?
options: I think I lost my keys at the office.
I think I left my keys at the office.
I think I lent my keys at the office.
questions.answer: I think I left my keys at the office.
questions.explanation: "Left" (past of leave) means the keys are still at the office, so the speaker can go back and get them. "Lost" would mean they don't know where the keys are.
questions.explanation_vi: "Left" (quá khứ của leave) nghĩa là để quên ở văn phòng, nên người nói có thể quay lại lấy. "Lost" là làm mất, không biết chìa khóa ở đâu.

questions.objective: Follow the order of activities in the evening
questions.audio_text: I usually cook dinner at eight. After that, I study English for thirty minutes before bed.
questions.prompt: What does the speaker do after dinner?
questions.prompt_vi: Người nói làm gì sau bữa tối?
questions.explanation: "After that" shows the next activity: studying English for thirty minutes before going to bed.
questions.explanation_vi: "After that" (sau đó) cho biết hoạt động tiếp theo: học tiếng Anh ba mươi phút trước khi đi ngủ.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between thirty and thirteen in a longer sentence
questions.audio_text: My sister is thirty years old, and she lives in the city with her husband.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the speaker's sister?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về chị/em gái của người nói?
options: My sister is thirteen years old, and she lives in the city with her husband.
My sister is thirty years old, and she lives in the city with her husband.
My sister is thirty years old, and she leaves the city with her husband.
questions.answer: My sister is thirty years old, and she lives in the city with her husband.
questions.explanation: You hear THIR-ty, stressed at the start, and "lives in" with a short /ɪ/. A sister with a husband is also more likely to be thirty than thirteen.
questions.explanation_vi: Bạn nghe THIR-ty (nhấn ở đầu) và "lives in" với âm i ngắn. Ngữ cảnh "sống với chồng" cũng cho thấy ba mươi tuổi hợp lý hơn mười ba.

questions.objective: Understand the cause of a problem on a video call
questions.audio_text: The light in my room is broken. That's why the video is so dark. I'll fix it tomorrow.
questions.prompt: Why is the video so dark?
questions.prompt_vi: Tại sao video lại tối như vậy?
options: The light in the room is broken
questions.answer: The light in the room is broken
questions.explanation: "That's why" connects the cause to the result: the broken light is the reason the video is dark.
questions.explanation_vi: "That's why" (đó là lý do) nối nguyên nhân với kết quả: đèn trong phòng bị hỏng nên video bị tối.

lessons.title: On the Way to You: Travel Listening
lessons.title_vi: Trên đường đến bên em: Nghe về du lịch
objectives: Understand announcements and requests while travelling
Hear the difference between ship / sheep and fifteen / fifty
Catch the main question in a hotel conversation

questions.objective: Understand where the speaker is going
questions.audio_text: Excuse me, does this train go to the airport? I have to check in by six o'clock.
questions.prompt: Where is the speaker going?
questions.prompt_vi: Người nói đang đi đâu?
questions.explanation: The speaker asks if the train goes "to the airport" and mentions checking in, which you do before a flight.
questions.explanation_vi: Người nói hỏi tàu có đi "to the airport" (đến sân bay) không, và nhắc đến "check in" là thủ tục trước khi bay. Họ đang ở trên tàu nên không phải đi đến nhà ga.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between ship and sheep in a travel story
questions.audio_text: We took a ship to the island, and the sea was very calm.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the island?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về hòn đảo?
options: We took a sheep to the island, and the sea was very calm.
We took a trip to the island, and the sea was very calm.
We took a ship to the island, and the sea was very calm.
questions.answer: We took a ship to the island, and the sea was very calm.
questions.explanation: "Ship" has a short, quick /ɪ/ sound. "Sheep" is longer, like "see". "Trip" starts with a different sound, tr.
questions.explanation_vi: "Ship" (con tàu) có âm i ngắn và nhanh. "Sheep" (con cừu) có âm i dài như "see". "Trip" bắt đầu bằng âm tr khác hẳn.

questions.objective: Understand what the speaker will do during a delay
questions.audio_text: Our flight is delayed by two hours, so we will have dinner at the airport. I will text you when we get on the plane.
questions.prompt: What will the speaker do while waiting?
questions.prompt_vi: Người nói sẽ làm gì trong lúc chờ?
questions.explanation: Because the flight is delayed, the speaker says "we will have dinner at the airport". "So" introduces the result of the delay.
questions.explanation_vi: Vì chuyến bay bị trễ, người nói bảo "we will have dinner at the airport" (tụi mình sẽ ăn tối ở sân bay). Từ "so" giới thiệu kết quả của việc bị trễ.

questions.objective: Hear the difference between fifteen and fifty in directions
questions.audio_text: The hotel is fifteen minutes from the beach, so we can walk there every morning.
questions.prompt: Which sentence did you hear about the hotel?
questions.prompt_vi: Bạn đã nghe câu nào về khách sạn?
options: The hotel is fifty minutes from the beach, so we can walk there every morning.
The hotel is fifteen minutes from the beach, so we can walk there every morning.
The hotel is five minutes from the beach, so we can walk there every morning.
questions.answer: The hotel is fifteen minutes from the beach, so we can walk there every morning.
questions.explanation: You hear fif-TEEN, with stress at the end and a clear n sound. Fifteen minutes is also a comfortable walk every morning.
questions.explanation_vi: Bạn nghe fif-TEEN, nhấn ở cuối và có âm n rõ. Mười lăm phút cũng là quãng đường đi bộ hợp lý mỗi sáng.

questions.objective: Catch the main question at a hotel reception
questions.audio_text: Hello, I would like a room for two nights, please. Does the price include breakfast?
questions.prompt: What does the speaker ask about?
questions.prompt_vi: Người nói hỏi về điều gì?
options: What time they must check out
questions.explanation: The question is "Does the price include breakfast?", so the speaker wants to know if breakfast is part of the price.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu hỏi là "Does the price include breakfast?" (giá phòng có bao gồm bữa sáng không?), nên người nói muốn biết bữa sáng có được tính trong giá không.
